data.desc: Andersen Group Inc. is a leading integrated professional services firm delivering tax, legal, valuation, global mobility and consulting services worldwide. Andersen's differentiated approach to client service is rooted in core values that emphasize stewardship, transparency, and the seamless delivery of independent, high-quality service. Andersen's platform spans 180 countries through affiliates, member and collaborating firms operating from more than 1,000 locations, with over 3,000 partners and 50,000 professionals.
